url.label: SoulSync URL
url.description: Base URL of your SoulSync server, e.g. http://192.168.1.129:8008.

api_key.label: API key
api_key.description: SoulSync API key (Settings > API). Leave empty to use the SOULSYNC_API_KEY environment variable of the server.

profile_id.label: SoulSync profile
profile_id.description: Id of the SoulSync profile whose wishlist and watchlist are used.

skip_local_tracks.label: Skip tracks already in the local library
skip_local_tracks.description: When adding an album, only the tracks that are missing locally are added to the wishlist.

refresh_interval.label: Library refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_interval.description: How often the SoulSync library, wishlist and watchlist are reloaded.

manifest.description: Add tracks and albums to your SoulSync wishlist and follow artists on the SoulSync watchlist, with badges for what is already in your local library.
